title: The ghost walks, professor MacHugh murmured softly, biscuitfully to the dusty windowpane.
html_source:
The ghost walks is Professor MacHugh’s way of saying “It’s payday”.

MacHugh is munching on a biscuit when he says this – “biscuitfully”.
